user.title: Sign in to Autobayt
user.description: Use the email and password of your Autobayt app account. Home Assistant keeps only the sign-in token, not your password.

data_description.host: Only change this if Autobayt gave you a different server address.

data_description.email: The email you sign in to the Autobayt app with.
data_description.password: Your Autobayt app password. It is used once to get a sign-in token and is not stored.

location.title: Choose a home
location.description: Pick the Autobayt location to add. Add the integration again for another location.

data_description.location_id: The Autobayt home whose devices to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Autobayt again
reauth_confirm.description: Autobayt no longer accepts the saved sign-in for {location}. Enter your password again.

data_description.email: The email you sign in to the Autobayt app with.
data_description.password: Your Autobayt app password. It is used once to get a sign-in token and is not stored.

reconfigure.title: Change the Autobayt sign-in
reconfigure.description: Sign in again for {location}, for example after changing your password or when Autobayt gives you a new server address. It must be the same Autobayt account.

data_description.email: The email you sign in to the Autobayt app with.
data_description.password: Your Autobayt app password. It is used once to get a sign-in token and is not stored.

data_description.host: Only change this if Autobayt gave you a different server address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Autobayt server.

abort.no_locations: This Autobayt account has no locations.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Autobayt account than the one this home was added with.
abort.location_missing: This Autobayt account no longer has this home.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Autobayt for switch states, in seconds.
data_description.shutter_models: Comma-separated model names to treat as shutters, if a shutter shows up as switches.
data_description.energy: Show power and today's energy for power-metering (PM) devices.
data_description.energy_timezone: IANA time zone that decides when the day starts, for example Asia/Amman. Defaults to the time zone of Home Assistant.
data_description.light_words: A channel whose name contains one of these comma-separated words is shown as a light; the rest are switches. The light channel on a shutter plate is always a light.

error.invalid_timezone: Not a known time zone. Use a name such as Europe/Berlin or Asia/Amman.

auth_failed.message: Autobayt no longer accepts the saved sign-in. Sign in again.

update_failed.message: Could not read the devices from Autobayt: {error}

energy_update_failed.message: Could not read energy from Autobayt: {error}

command_failed.message: Autobayt did not accept the command: {error}

shutter_control_unavailable.message: Shutters cannot be controlled from Home Assistant yet: Autobayt has not published a way to control them. Use the Autobayt app.
